acceptance_gates: Each scheduled cell yields a unique run identifier, task-record hash, model identifier, start/end time, input/output/reasoning/cache token usage, tool-call count, terminal status and raw evaluator result.
The official evaluator or hidden test can be rerun independently from the agent trace and returns the same terminal verdict.
Every system uses the same DeepSeek model, temperature, server-default reasoning mode and per-family budget; unsupported systems are recorded as not applicable, never imitated.
Any ordinary timeout, agent crash, tool failure or malformed result remains a failed cell; only host-wide outage or evidence-store failure triggers a rerun after recording the incident.
